# Generated by scripts/generate_rural_capacity_values.py for farming.
# Keep these values flat: EU5 displays scripted-value rows in building
# max-level tooltips, and nested helpers create confusing extra rows.

farm_capacity = {
	# Public remaining-capacity path for map modes and new-building gates.
	# Capacity buildings subtract their levels directly from this sum.
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_BASE_FARM_RGO"
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pp_farm_base_capacity }
			value = var:pp_farm_base_capacity
		}
		else = { value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_farm_base_capacity }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_RGO_SIZE_FARMING"
			value = var:pp_farm_base_capacity
			multiply = max_rgo_workers
			multiply = 0.125
		}
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_POPULATION_CAPACITY_FARMING"
		value = modifier:local_population_capacity
		multiply = 0.10
	}
	if = {
		limit = { location_rank = location_rank:megalopolis }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_LOCATION_RANK"
			value = -20
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { location_rank = location_rank:city }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_LOCATION_RANK"
			value = -5
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { location_rank = location_rank:town }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_LOCATION_RANK"
			value = -1
		}
	}
	add = {
		# River size is bridged through a source-specific modifier so it remains a
		# visible row for locations whose river size is stored on static modifiers.
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_RIVER"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_river_size
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_town_rights = town_rights_type:manorial_customals }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_MANORIAL_CUSTOMALS"
			value = 1
		}
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_IRRIGATION_SYSTEMS"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_irrigation_systems
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_BUND"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_bund
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_TERRACES"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_terraces
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_POLDERS"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_polders
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_KHMER_BARAY"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_khmer_baray
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_AQUEDUCT_SYSTEM"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_aqueduct_system
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_FARMING_VILLAGE"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_farming_village
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_HUSBANDRY_FARMSTEAD"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_husbandry_farmstead
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_FARMING_VILLAGE_ROTATIONS"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_farming_village_rotations
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_MODEL_FARM"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_model_farm
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_FRUIT_ORCHARD"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_fruit_orchard
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_NURSERY_ORCHARD"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_nursery_orchard
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_POMOLOGICAL_ORCHARD"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_pomological_orchard
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_SHEEP_FARMS"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_sheep_farms
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_HURDLED_SHEEPCOTES"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_hurdled_sheepcotes
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_ENCLOSED_SHEEP_WALKS"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_enclosed_sheep_walks
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_HORSE_BREEDERS"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_horse_breeders
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_STUD_FARM"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_stud_farm
	}
	add = {

		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_coffee_grove
	}
	add = {

		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_terraced_coffee_grove

		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_saffron_croft

# Per-building max-level paths. Each one is the same flat capacity sum
# but omits that building's own capacity-consumption row.

farm_capacity_max_farming_village_rotations = {
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_BASE_FARM_RGO"
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pp_farm_base_capacity }
			value = var:pp_farm_base_capacity
		}
		else = { value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_farm_base_capacity }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_RGO_SIZE_FARMING"
			value = var:pp_farm_base_capacity
			multiply = max_rgo_workers
			multiply = 0.125
		}
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_POPULATION_CAPACITY_FARMING"
		value = modifier:local_population_capacity
		multiply = 0.10
	}
	if = {
		limit = { location_rank = location_rank:megalopolis }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_LOCATION_RANK"
			value = -20
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { location_rank = location_rank:city }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_LOCATION_RANK"
			value = -5
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { location_rank = location_rank:town }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_LOCATION_RANK"
			value = -1
		}
	}
	add = {
		# River size is bridged through a source-specific modifier so it remains a
		# visible row for locations whose river size is stored on static modifiers.
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_RIVER"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_river_size
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_town_rights = town_rights_type:manorial_customals }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_MANORIAL_CUSTOMALS"
			value = 1
		}
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_IRRIGATION_SYSTEMS"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_irrigation_systems
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_BUND"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_bund
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_TERRACES"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_terraces
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_POLDERS"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_polders
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_KHMER_BARAY"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_khmer_baray
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_AQUEDUCT_SYSTEM"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_aqueduct_system
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_FARMING_VILLAGE"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_farming_village
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_HUSBANDRY_FARMSTEAD"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_husbandry_farmstead
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_MODEL_FARM"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_model_farm
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_FRUIT_ORCHARD"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_fruit_orchard
	}
	add = {

		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_nursery_orchard
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_POMOLOGICAL_ORCHARD"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_pomological_orchard
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_SHEEP_FARMS"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_sheep_farms
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_HURDLED_SHEEPCOTES"

	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_BASE_FARM_RGO"
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pp_farm_base_capacity }
			value = var:pp_farm_base_capacity
		}
		else = { value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_farm_base_capacity }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_RGO_SIZE_FARMING"

			multiply = max_rgo_workers
			multiply = 0.125
		}
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_POPULATION_CAPACITY_FARMING"

			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_LOCATION_RANK"
			value = -1
		}
	}
	add = {
		# River size is bridged through a source-specific modifier so it remains a
		# visible row for locations whose river size is stored on static modifiers.
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_RIVER"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_river_size

farm_capacity_max_sheep_farms = {
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_BASE_FARM_RGO"
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pp_farm_base_capacity }
			value = var:pp_farm_base_capacity
		}
		else = { value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_farm_base_capacity }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_RGO_SIZE_FARMING"
			value = var:pp_farm_base_capacity
			multiply = max_rgo_workers
			multiply = 0.125
		}
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_POPULATION_CAPACITY_FARMING"
		value = modifier:local_population_capacity
		multiply = 0.10
	}
	if = {
		limit = { location_rank = location_rank:megalopolis }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_LOCATION_RANK"
			value = -20
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { location_rank = location_rank:city }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_LOCATION_RANK"
			value = -5
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { location_rank = location_rank:town }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_LOCATION_RANK"
			value = -1
		}
	}
	add = {
		# River size is bridged through a source-specific modifier so it remains a
		# visible row for locations whose river size is stored on static modifiers.
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_RIVER"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_river_size
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_town_rights = town_rights_type:manorial_customals }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_MANORIAL_CUSTOMALS"
			value = 1
		}
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_IRRIGATION_SYSTEMS"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_irrigation_systems
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_BUND"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_bund
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_TERRACES"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_terraces
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_POLDERS"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_polders
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_KHMER_BARAY"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_khmer_baray
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_AQUEDUCT_SYSTEM"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_aqueduct_system
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_FARMING_VILLAGE"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_farming_village
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_HUSBANDRY_FARMSTEAD"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_husbandry_farmstead
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_FARMING_VILLAGE_ROTATIONS"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_farming_village_rotations
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_MODEL_FARM"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_model_farm
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_FRUIT_ORCHARD"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_fruit_orchard
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_NURSERY_ORCHARD"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_nursery_orchard
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_POMOLOGICAL_ORCHARD"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_pomological_orchard
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_HURDLED_SHEEPCOTES"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_hurdled_sheepcotes
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_ENCLOSED_SHEEP_WALKS"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_enclosed_sheep_walks
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_HORSE_BREEDERS"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_horse_breeders
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_STUD_FARM"

		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_river_size

farm_capacity_max_elephant_kraal = {
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_BASE_FARM_RGO"
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pp_farm_base_capacity }
			value = var:pp_farm_base_capacity
		}
		else = { value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_farm_base_capacity }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_RGO_SIZE_FARMING"
			value = var:pp_farm_base_capacity
			multiply = max_rgo_workers
			multiply = 0.125
		}
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_POPULATION_CAPACITY_FARMING"
		value = modifier:local_population_capacity
		multiply = 0.10
	}
	if = {
		limit = { location_rank = location_rank:megalopolis }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_LOCATION_RANK"
			value = -20
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { location_rank = location_rank:city }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_LOCATION_RANK"
			value = -5
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { location_rank = location_rank:town }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_LOCATION_RANK"
			value = -1
		}
	}
	add = {
		# River size is bridged through a source-specific modifier so it remains a
		# visible row for locations whose river size is stored on static modifiers.
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_RIVER"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_river_size
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_town_rights = town_rights_type:manorial_customals }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_MANORIAL_CUSTOMALS"
			value = 1
		}
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_IRRIGATION_SYSTEMS"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_irrigation_systems
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_BUND"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_bund
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_TERRACES"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_terraces
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_POLDERS"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_polders
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_KHMER_BARAY"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_khmer_baray
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_AQUEDUCT_SYSTEM"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_aqueduct_system
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_FARMING_VILLAGE"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_farming_village
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_HUSBANDRY_FARMSTEAD"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_husbandry_farmstead
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_FARMING_VILLAGE_ROTATIONS"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_farming_village_rotations
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_MODEL_FARM"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_model_farm
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_FRUIT_ORCHARD"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_fruit_orchard
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_NURSERY_ORCHARD"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_nursery_orchard
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_POMOLOGICAL_ORCHARD"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_pomological_orchard
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_SHEEP_FARMS"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_sheep_farms
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_HURDLED_SHEEPCOTES"

farm_capacity_max_market_cotton_farm = {
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_BASE_FARM_RGO"
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pp_farm_base_capacity }
			value = var:pp_farm_base_capacity
		}
		else = { value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_farm_base_capacity }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_RGO_SIZE_FARMING"
			value = var:pp_farm_base_capacity
			multiply = max_rgo_workers
			multiply = 0.125
		}
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_POPULATION_CAPACITY_FARMING"
		value = modifier:local_population_capacity
		multiply = 0.10
	}
	if = {
		limit = { location_rank = location_rank:megalopolis }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_LOCATION_RANK"
			value = -20
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { location_rank = location_rank:city }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_LOCATION_RANK"
			value = -5
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { location_rank = location_rank:town }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_LOCATION_RANK"
			value = -1
		}
	}
	add = {
		# River size is bridged through a source-specific modifier so it remains a
		# visible row for locations whose river size is stored on static modifiers.
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_RIVER"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_river_size
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_town_rights = town_rights_type:manorial_customals }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_MANORIAL_CUSTOMALS"
			value = 1
		}
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_IRRIGATION_SYSTEMS"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_irrigation_systems
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_BUND"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_bund
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_TERRACES"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_terraces
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_POLDERS"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_polders
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_KHMER_BARAY"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_khmer_baray
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_AQUEDUCT_SYSTEM"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_aqueduct_system
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_FARMING_VILLAGE"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_farming_village
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_HUSBANDRY_FARMSTEAD"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_husbandry_farmstead
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_FARMING_VILLAGE_ROTATIONS"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_farming_village_rotations
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_MODEL_FARM"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_model_farm
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_FRUIT_ORCHARD"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_fruit_orchard
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_NURSERY_ORCHARD"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_nursery_orchard
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_POMOLOGICAL_ORCHARD"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_pomological_orchard
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_SHEEP_FARMS"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_sheep_farms
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_HURDLED_SHEEPCOTES"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_hurdled_sheepcotes
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_ENCLOSED_SHEEP_WALKS"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_enclosed_sheep_walks
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_HORSE_BREEDERS"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_horse_breeders

		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_MARKET_COTTON_FARM"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_market_cotton_farm

		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_SUGAR_PLANTATION"

farm_capacity_max_tobacco_farm = {
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_BASE_FARM_RGO"
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pp_farm_base_capacity }
			value = var:pp_farm_base_capacity
		}
		else = { value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_farm_base_capacity }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_RGO_SIZE_FARMING"
			value = var:pp_farm_base_capacity
			multiply = max_rgo_workers
			multiply = 0.125
		}
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_POPULATION_CAPACITY_FARMING"
		value = modifier:local_population_capacity
		multiply = 0.10
	}
	if = {
		limit = { location_rank = location_rank:megalopolis }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_LOCATION_RANK"
			value = -20
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { location_rank = location_rank:city }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_LOCATION_RANK"
			value = -5
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { location_rank = location_rank:town }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_LOCATION_RANK"
			value = -1
		}
	}
	add = {
		# River size is bridged through a source-specific modifier so it remains a
		# visible row for locations whose river size is stored on static modifiers.
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_RIVER"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_river_size
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_town_rights = town_rights_type:manorial_customals }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_MANORIAL_CUSTOMALS"
			value = 1
		}
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_IRRIGATION_SYSTEMS"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_irrigation_systems
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_BUND"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_bund
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_TERRACES"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_terraces
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_POLDERS"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_polders
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_KHMER_BARAY"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_khmer_baray
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_AQUEDUCT_SYSTEM"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_aqueduct_system
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_FARMING_VILLAGE"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_farming_village
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_HUSBANDRY_FARMSTEAD"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_husbandry_farmstead
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_FARMING_VILLAGE_ROTATIONS"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_farming_village_rotations
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_MODEL_FARM"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_model_farm
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_FRUIT_ORCHARD"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_fruit_orchard
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_NURSERY_ORCHARD"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_nursery_orchard
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_POMOLOGICAL_ORCHARD"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_pomological_orchard
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_SHEEP_FARMS"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_sheep_farms
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_HURDLED_SHEEPCOTES"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_hurdled_sheepcotes
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_ENCLOSED_SHEEP_WALKS"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_enclosed_sheep_walks
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_HORSE_BREEDERS"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_horse_breeders
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_STUD_FARM"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_stud_farm
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_ELEPHANT_KRAAL"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_elephant_kraal
	}

	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_FIBER_DRESSING_YARD"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_fiber_dressing_yard
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_COTTON_PLANTATION"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_cotton_plantation
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_COTTON_FARM"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_cotton_farm
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_MARKET_COTTON_FARM"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_market_cotton_farm
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_SUGAR_PLANTATION"

	}

	}
	add = {

	}

	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_CLOVE_GROVE"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_clove_grove
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_COCOA_GROVE"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_cocoa_grove
	}
	add = {

	}

		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_pepper_garden
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_MANAGED_PEPPER_GARDEN"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_managed_pepper_garden
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_SAFFRON_CROFT"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_saffron_croft
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_SAFFRON_KILN_CROFT"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_saffron_kiln_croft
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_SERICULTURE_FARM"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_sericulture_farm
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_REGULATED_SERICULTURE_FARM"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_regulated_sericulture_farm
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_SIMPLERS_GROVE"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_simplers_grove
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_TEA_GARDEN"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_tea_garden

		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_TEA_SORTING_GARDEN"

	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_BASE_FARM_RGO"
		if = {

		}
		else = { value = 0 }
	}

		limit = { has_variable = pp_farm_base_capacity }

			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_RGO_SIZE_FARMING"

			multiply = max_rgo_workers
			multiply = 0.125
		}

farm_capacity_max_cocoa_grove = {
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_BASE_FARM_RGO"
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pp_farm_base_capacity }
			value = var:pp_farm_base_capacity
		}
		else = { value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_farm_base_capacity }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_RGO_SIZE_FARMING"
			value = var:pp_farm_base_capacity
			multiply = max_rgo_workers
			multiply = 0.125
		}
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_POPULATION_CAPACITY_FARMING"
		value = modifier:local_population_capacity
		multiply = 0.10
	}
	if = {
		limit = { location_rank = location_rank:megalopolis }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_LOCATION_RANK"
			value = -20
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { location_rank = location_rank:city }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_LOCATION_RANK"
			value = -5
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { location_rank = location_rank:town }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_LOCATION_RANK"
			value = -1
		}
	}
	add = {
		# River size is bridged through a source-specific modifier so it remains a
		# visible row for locations whose river size is stored on static modifiers.
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_RIVER"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_river_size
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_town_rights = town_rights_type:manorial_customals }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_MANORIAL_CUSTOMALS"
			value = 1
		}
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_IRRIGATION_SYSTEMS"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_irrigation_systems
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_BUND"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_bund
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_TERRACES"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_terraces
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_POLDERS"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_polders
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_KHMER_BARAY"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_khmer_baray
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_AQUEDUCT_SYSTEM"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_aqueduct_system
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_FARMING_VILLAGE"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_farming_village
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_HUSBANDRY_FARMSTEAD"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_husbandry_farmstead
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_FARMING_VILLAGE_ROTATIONS"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_farming_village_rotations
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_MODEL_FARM"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_model_farm
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_FRUIT_ORCHARD"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_fruit_orchard
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_NURSERY_ORCHARD"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_nursery_orchard
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_POMOLOGICAL_ORCHARD"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_pomological_orchard
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_SHEEP_FARMS"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_sheep_farms
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_HURDLED_SHEEPCOTES"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_hurdled_sheepcotes
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_ENCLOSED_SHEEP_WALKS"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_enclosed_sheep_walks
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_HORSE_BREEDERS"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_horse_breeders
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_STUD_FARM"

	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_BASE_FARM_RGO"

		}
		else = { value = 0 }

		limit = { has_variable = pp_farm_base_capacity }

			multiply = max_rgo_workers
			multiply = 0.125
		}

		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_TRAPICHE_SUGARCANE_FARM"

farm_capacity_max_pepper_garden = {
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_BASE_FARM_RGO"
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pp_farm_base_capacity }
			value = var:pp_farm_base_capacity
		}
		else = { value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_farm_base_capacity }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_RGO_SIZE_FARMING"
			value = var:pp_farm_base_capacity
			multiply = max_rgo_workers
			multiply = 0.125
		}
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_POPULATION_CAPACITY_FARMING"
		value = modifier:local_population_capacity
		multiply = 0.10
	}
	if = {
		limit = { location_rank = location_rank:megalopolis }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_LOCATION_RANK"
			value = -20
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { location_rank = location_rank:city }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_LOCATION_RANK"
			value = -5
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { location_rank = location_rank:town }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_LOCATION_RANK"
			value = -1
		}
	}
	add = {
		# River size is bridged through a source-specific modifier so it remains a
		# visible row for locations whose river size is stored on static modifiers.
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_RIVER"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_river_size
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_town_rights = town_rights_type:manorial_customals }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_MANORIAL_CUSTOMALS"
			value = 1
		}
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_IRRIGATION_SYSTEMS"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_irrigation_systems
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_BUND"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_bund
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_TERRACES"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_terraces
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_POLDERS"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_polders
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_KHMER_BARAY"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_khmer_baray
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_AQUEDUCT_SYSTEM"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_aqueduct_system
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_FARMING_VILLAGE"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_farming_village
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_HUSBANDRY_FARMSTEAD"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_husbandry_farmstead
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_FARMING_VILLAGE_ROTATIONS"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_farming_village_rotations
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_MODEL_FARM"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_model_farm
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_FRUIT_ORCHARD"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_fruit_orchard
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_NURSERY_ORCHARD"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_nursery_orchard
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_POMOLOGICAL_ORCHARD"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_pomological_orchard
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_SHEEP_FARMS"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_sheep_farms
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_HURDLED_SHEEPCOTES"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_hurdled_sheepcotes
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_ENCLOSED_SHEEP_WALKS"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_enclosed_sheep_walks
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_HORSE_BREEDERS"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_horse_breeders
	}

		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_STUD_FARM"

	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_CLOVE_GROVE"

		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_TEA_GARDEN"

farm_capacity_max_saffron_kiln_croft = {
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_BASE_FARM_RGO"
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pp_farm_base_capacity }
			value = var:pp_farm_base_capacity
		}
		else = { value = 0 }
	}

		limit = { has_variable = pp_farm_base_capacity }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_RGO_SIZE_FARMING"

			multiply = max_rgo_workers
			multiply = 0.125
		}

		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_POPULATION_CAPACITY_FARMING"

		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_TOBACCO_FARM"

farm_capacity_max_regulated_sericulture_farm = {
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_BASE_FARM_RGO"
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pp_farm_base_capacity }
			value = var:pp_farm_base_capacity
		}
		else = { value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_farm_base_capacity }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_RGO_SIZE_FARMING"
			value = var:pp_farm_base_capacity
			multiply = max_rgo_workers
			multiply = 0.125
		}
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_POPULATION_CAPACITY_FARMING"
		value = modifier:local_population_capacity
		multiply = 0.10
	}
	if = {
		limit = { location_rank = location_rank:megalopolis }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_LOCATION_RANK"
			value = -20
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { location_rank = location_rank:city }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_LOCATION_RANK"
			value = -5
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { location_rank = location_rank:town }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_LOCATION_RANK"
			value = -1
		}
	}
	add = {
		# River size is bridged through a source-specific modifier so it remains a
		# visible row for locations whose river size is stored on static modifiers.
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_RIVER"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_river_size
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_town_rights = town_rights_type:manorial_customals }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_MANORIAL_CUSTOMALS"
			value = 1
		}
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_IRRIGATION_SYSTEMS"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_irrigation_systems
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_BUND"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_bund
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_TERRACES"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_terraces
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_POLDERS"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_polders
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_KHMER_BARAY"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_khmer_baray
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_AQUEDUCT_SYSTEM"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_aqueduct_system
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_FARMING_VILLAGE"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_farming_village
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_HUSBANDRY_FARMSTEAD"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_husbandry_farmstead
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_FARMING_VILLAGE_ROTATIONS"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_farming_village_rotations
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_MODEL_FARM"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_model_farm
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_FRUIT_ORCHARD"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_fruit_orchard
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_NURSERY_ORCHARD"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_nursery_orchard
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_POMOLOGICAL_ORCHARD"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_pomological_orchard
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_SHEEP_FARMS"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_sheep_farms
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_HURDLED_SHEEPCOTES"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_hurdled_sheepcotes
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_ENCLOSED_SHEEP_WALKS"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_enclosed_sheep_walks
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_HORSE_BREEDERS"

farm_capacity_max_tea_sorting_garden = {
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_BASE_FARM_RGO"
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = pp_farm_base_capacity }
			value = var:pp_farm_base_capacity
		}
		else = { value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = pp_farm_base_capacity }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_RGO_SIZE_FARMING"
			value = var:pp_farm_base_capacity
			multiply = max_rgo_workers
			multiply = 0.125
		}
	}
	add = {
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_POPULATION_CAPACITY_FARMING"
		value = modifier:local_population_capacity
		multiply = 0.10
	}
	if = {
		limit = { location_rank = location_rank:megalopolis }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_LOCATION_RANK"
			value = -20
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { location_rank = location_rank:city }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_LOCATION_RANK"
			value = -5
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { location_rank = location_rank:town }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_LOCATION_RANK"
			value = -1
		}
	}
	add = {
		# River size is bridged through a source-specific modifier so it remains a
		# visible row for locations whose river size is stored on static modifiers.
		desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_RIVER"
		value = modifier:farm_capacity_from_river_size
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_town_rights = town_rights_type:manorial_customals }
		add = {
			desc = "BUILDING_LEVEL_FARM_MANORIAL_CUSTOMALS"
			value = 1
		}
